messages.author: 46ae83b02283d9c3
messages.subject: * Unable to deploy package dependency 'Vennerable'
parts:
Hi,

While trying to deploy my application, I encountered with the following message

Preparing to deploy application...
Update application currently deployed at
http://ash-apps.shinyapps.io/once_test? [Y/n] Y
DONE
Uploading application bundle...
Error: 
* Unable to deploy package dependency 'Vennerable'
   
   The package was installed from an unsupported repository 'R-Forge'. Only
   packages installed from CRAN, BioConductor and GitHub are supported.


  The "Vennerable" package is supported by R-forge http://r-forge.r-project.org/projects/vennerable. 

Here is the package description:

> packageDescription('Vennerable')
Package: Vennerable
Title: Venn and Euler area-proportional diagrams
Version: 3.0
Author: Jonathan Swinton
Description: A package for drawing various species of Venn diagrams.
Maintainer: Jonathan Swinton
LazyLoad: yes
Depends: R (>= 2.10), graph, RBGL, grid, lattice, RColorBrewer, reshape,
        methods, gtools, xtable
License: GPL
Repository: R-Forge
Repository/R-Forge/Project: vennerable
Repository/R-Forge/Revision: 82
Repository/R-Forge/DateTimeStamp: 2013-07-24 22:16:12
Date/Publication: 2013-07-24 22:16:12
Packaged: 2013-07-25 02:41:56 UTC; rforge
Built: R 3.1.0; ; 2014-04-28 19:29:12 UTC; unix

-- File: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.1/Resources/library/Vennerable/Meta/package.rds 

 I am not knowing how to solve this. Any help or advices is of great help...

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] * Unable to deploy package dependency 'Vennerable'
